POST /accounts/{account_id}/custom_csrs.description: Generate a new custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for an account. Cloudflare generates and securely stores the private key associated with the CSR.

schema.description: Request body for creating a custom CSR.

common_name.description: The common name (domain) for the CSR. Must be at most 64 characters.

key_type.description: Key algorithm to use for the CSR. Defaults to rsa2048 if not specified.

sans.description: Subject Alternative Names for the CSR. At least one SAN is required.
